events.title: PlayCard is Ready for You
events.summary: Playcard Football 0.8 · The Facility Update Your program finally has a building. This release (0.8) turns the career screens into rooms you walk between, brings the league to life with a weekly social feed and real football stats, and rebuilds game day from the play call to the final whistle. Welcome to the facility A row of brass room placards now runs across the top, and each room changes its look as you climb from High School to College to the Pros. Press 1 to 6 to jump between them. Office.

events.title: Dev Journal 2
events.summary: Playing football games, more than I can count, I was looking for something new to interact with. I didn't want to micromanage a team, but i did want to manage a team. I wanted to deal with building a profile like a defensive mastermind but I didn't want to have to deal with hundreds of plays to choose from. events.title: Dev Journal 1
events.summary: I've been playing football video games since Tecmo bowl.I've been working on this football game for 5 years. Wanted to make a game that felt the way football feels; with the players, strategy and play calling that makes it the "physical chess" that many people can see. I'm very lucky to say I've created a version of a game that captures all of that.In this game you are a coach.
